content.short: aelf is an AI-enhanced, modular Layer 1 blockchain featuring a unique multi-sidechain architecture for scalability.
content.description: aelf is a high-performance, AI-enhanced Layer 1 blockchain designed to support enterprise-grade decentralized applications through a unique modular architecture. It utilizes a "Mainchain + multi-Sidechain" structure that enables parallel processing and unlimited scalability, targeting transaction speeds of over 35,000 TPS. Built with C# to ensure developer accessibility, aelf provides a flexible framework for customized sidechains tailored to specific business needs. The network is secured by a Delegated Proof of Stake mechanism, aiming to power the future digital economy and global enterprise adoption.
content.meta: aelf provides a modular, AI-integrated Layer 1 blockchain for enterprise scalability. Discover aelf and other Blockchains on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
